subject: SIG Q&A + evidence mapping for Clearmap integration
messages:
From: John Park <john.park@clearmap.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@clearmap.io>, security@clearmap.io
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: SIG review request + scheduling - Clearmap x Redwood

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week — Clearmap's security team has started our SIG/CAIQ review for the upcoming integration. We'd like to run through the SIG response with your team and confirm where we need artifacts (logs, diagram exports, SOC2 snippets).

High-level asks:
- 45 minute sync to go over the SIG spreadsheet and confirm evidence owners
- Share any baseline artefacts (network diagram, data residency statement, SOC 2 scope summary) in advance
- Clarify key management + encryption-at-rest/backups questions during the call

Available windows (US Eastern):
- Tue 12/01 10:00-11:00 or 14:00-14:45
- Wed 12/02 09:00-09:45 or 16:00-16:45

I've attached our working SIG export (PDF) to help structure the call. If you prefer, send over a proposed agenda and evidence list and we'll confirm.

Thanks,
John Park
Senior Security Program Manager
Clearmap Analytics

[Attachment: clearmap-sig-caiq.pdf (pdf, 210KB)]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: John Park <john.park@clearmap.io>
Cc: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@clearmap.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG review request + scheduling - Clearmap x Redwood

John — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. We're glad to run through the SIG with you. Proposed plan below so we can lock the slot and make sure owners have the right artifacts preloaded.

Proposed slot: Tue 12/01 14:00-14:45 ET (45 minutes) — if that doesn't work, Wed 12/02 09:00 ET is our backup.

Proposed agenda (attached as PDF):
1) 5m intros + objectives
2) 20m walkthrough of SIG areas where you requested artifacts (data flows, controls, logging)
3) 15m Q&A: KMS, backups, network boundaries, tenant isolation
4) 5m next steps and evidence handoff cadence

Pre-call request: please confirm any specific SIG control IDs you want to prioritize (we can pre-populate attachments for those).

Evidence we will share in advance (owners in parentheses):
- SOC 2 scope & assertion (Marissa Cole)
- Network diagram + VPC peering notes (Ben Carter)
- Data residency statement & retention policy (Rachel Kim)
- Logging examples (system audit trail, access logs) (Ben Carter)

I've attached our Redwood evidence checklist to map to your PDF; we'll upload the artifacts to the Drive link below once owners confirm.

Looking forward — I'll calendar-in the slot tentatively and send a meeting invite after you confirm.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG review request + scheduling - Clearmap x Redwood

Rachel / Ben — quick internal note before the call. I'll take SOC2 scope + assertion export (we have the latest PDF from the auditor). Ben, can you pull: network diagram (current VPC layout + peering), CloudTrail sample (trimmed), and the ingress/egress rule summary?

Ben — ETA for artifacts to be uploaded to the Drive folder? If possible let's get them by EOD today so Rachel can add to the pre-read.

Also — do we want to include a short statement on our encryption key lifecycle? I can draft a one-pager and add it to the folder.

Marissa
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: John Park <john.park@clearmap.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@clearmap.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SIG review request + scheduling - Clearmap x Redwood

Thanks Rachel — Tue 12/01 14:00 ET works for us. Confirming a couple quick items ahead of time so we can triage internally:

1) For KMS/key management: do you use a customer-managed key option for Dedicated/private deployments, and can you provide the KM lifecycle doc (creation, rotation cadence, access control)?
2) Backups: are backups encrypted at rest with separate keys, and what is the retention policy for backups associated with customer data?

If you can drop a short blurb on each into the Drive folder before the call that would be ideal.

Also, note that Alice may forward two SIG control IDs that are high priority for Clearmap — we'll flag them in the pre-read.

John
